articles.title: Live updates: Bitcoin holds near $82,000 as Nasdaq rebounds more than 1%
articles.snippet: Bitcoin treasury company Strive continued to add large numbers of BTC to its balance sheet, while far larger peer Strategy acquired only a small amount.

articles.title: Bitcoin mining offshoot Nscale loses Microsoft AI deal as power delay stretches into 2030s
articles.snippet: The Nvidia-backed company planned to deliver 23,000 AI chips in the U.K. next year, but its grid connection may not be ready until the 2030s.

articles.title: Zcash developers plan a fix to keep ZEC swaps private from future quantum computers
articles.snippet: The team behind Zakura wants every swap through NEAR Intents to get its own key, so a refund address left on NEAR’s public chain can’t expose a user’s wider payment history.

articles.title: SEC tokenized stock framework faces issuer pushback as Broadcom, Verizon object to OKX-ICE listing
articles.snippet: Eight more companies objected to trading on the planned OKX-ICE venue, while Nasdaq has separately said it would opt out under the SEC’s framework.

articles.title: Crypto audits give investors false sense of security as Q3 hacks cost $1.18 billion, Hacken says
articles.snippet: The security firm found that 77% of third-quarter losses involved compromised suppliers, delayed fixes or systems outside the latest security reviews.
